cap: Above the pectinate line the anal canal is hindgut endoderm: columnar lining, adenocarcinoma, painless internal hemorrhoids, superior rectal vessels to the portal system and internal iliac nodes. Below it is ectoderm: squamous lining, squamous cell carcinoma, painful external hemorrhoids, inferior rectal vessels and nerve, caval drainage and superficial inguinal nodes. The internal sphincter is smooth and involuntary; the external sphincter is skeletal and voluntary.
